project: Lumi actual-geometry review and connected editing
scope: Local-only generate/render/review/scoped-correction loop; mounted editing; preservation and evidence. No deployment.

integrations.purpose: Inspect actual rendered candidates, propose scoped corrections, then review their new renders against a frozen brief.

checks.expected: Actual candidate renders go to Argon; scoped correction is rendered and reviewed again.
checks.observed: Real sensor with deliberately floating ESP32 module: two reviews and six WebGL images; reported placement issues 1 to 0; original IDs, source identity and unrelated geometry preserved. Model finding, not physical verification.

checks.expected: A fresh prompt generates an original object and runs automatic visual review.
checks.observed: Fresh desktop fan: 11 parts, 91 custom solids, sourced bearing-608, 8 mounts; one three-view Argon review reported no required correction.

checks.expected: Mounted components follow a parent edit; one undo restores all changes and report validity.
checks.observed: Production browser moved motor housing Y by 5 mm; motor, sourced bearing and grille followed; exported document after one undo equals baseline exactly.

checks.expected: Cancelling a pending review never replaces the saved document or report.
checks.observed: Browser cancelled during Argon inspection; saved report restored; exported document equals original reviewed fan exactly.

checks.expected: Saved evidence survives reload/import and full comparison opens.
checks.observed: Production browser reloaded and imported reviewed fan; brief, recorded images and findings restored. Comparison dialog opened and Escape closed it.

checks.expected: Automated geometry, transaction, scope, integrity and rollback checks pass.
checks.observed: 275 tests passed, 4 optional billable provider suites skipped; live checks were performed separately.
Next.js production build completed; production server started on 127.0.0.1:3001.

checks.expected: Production viewport and report render visibly.
checks.observed: Inspected GPU fan and recorded views in production browser; latest browser console error query returned no entries.

checks.expected: Existing server-only Gemini configuration remains available.
checks.observed: Production status reports available and model gemini-4-argon. This is availability evidence; C001/C002 supply actual inference evidence.

checks.expected: Force a software-only browser session and exercise complete fallback controls.
checks.observed: Not forced in this session. Unit tests exercised depth buffering, pixel picking, complete triangles, source CAD and saved sofa/sensor renders; current live browser used WebGL.

checks.expected: Evaluate all remaining object briefs with live generation and review.
checks.observed: Eight of twelve evaluation briefs remain unrun. Two live cases and two local regression cases are recorded; no general success rate is claimed.

checks.expected: Establish physical fit, structural loads, wiring and firmware behavior.
checks.observed: No physical hardware was connected or tested. Image findings and geometry checks do not establish these properties.
